reader.requirement: At --std 85, processing an RH, PH, CH, PF or RF group (a) runs its USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure first, (b) then stops if SUPPRESS was executed or the group has no print line (nonprintable), with no page advance, NEXT GROUP or LINE-COUNTER change, and (c) otherwise presents it under its presentation rules.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.ControlFootingPageGroupsSeePriorControlValues (2002+): which control values a page heading or footing reached from a footing phase sees; not which groups are processed or where

reader.edition-search: grep Edition|DialectBehavior in ReportWriter.cs: BeginGroup, RunBeforeReporting and SuppressPrinting consult none; the only switch on these presentations is the control-value exchange around page groups
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f29_04 covers a suppressed CH FINAL and presented RH, CH and RF; a nonprintable CH FINAL whose USE runs, a suppressed RH carrying NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE (no page advance) and a suppressed PH are exercised by probe ptype1

probes.printed: stdout INITIATED, U-RH1, U-PH1 1, U-CHF1, U-PF1 1, U-PH1 2, R2 SUMMARY, U-RH2, U-D2, R2 DETAIL, U-D2, TERMINATE, U-PF1 2, U-RF1; file 1 page 1: PH 1 on L1, DE 1-3 on L3-5, PF 1 on L9; page 2: no PH, DE 4-5 on L3-4, PF 2 on L9, RF on L10; file 2: RH2 L2, PH2 L3, DE2 L4, PF2 L8, RF2 L9; file 3 empty and U-RH3 never runs
probes.expected: RH1 suppressed although it has NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE: no page advance, PH first at HEADING; nonprintable CH FINAL runs its USE only; suppressed PH on page 2; GENERATE report-name as the first GENERATE processes the RH and the detail's USE but prints no detail (§1985:XIII.4.3.4 GR1); TERMINATE with no GENERATE processes no RH

OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR9b  the text is in GR9b (quoted: "there is no further processing to be done for the report group")

reader.notes: BeginGroup runs the USE (RunBeforeReporting) before the presence snapshot and returns false when SUPPRESS ran or no line exists, so every caller returns before PresentLines and ApplyNextGroup: in ptype1 the suppressed RH1 with NEXT GROUP NEXT PAGE causes no page advance and PH1 prints on line 1 of page 1. A 1985 printable group is one with at least one print line, which is BeginGroup's first >= 0 test.

refuter.evidence: rtype3-001 R1: a CH suppressed by its USE at a break where it would have overflowed caused no page advance and left LC 9 (U-CH1 K=2 LC=9, then U-D1 4 LC=9). The advance came only from the detail. rtype2-003: an unsuppressed CH whose fit failed ran its USE before the PF/PH advance (U-CH1 K=2, U-PF1, U-PH1), and then printed on page 2 at FIRST DETAIL. rtype3-001 R2: nonprintable RH, PH, PF and RF each ran their USE, and LC stayed 0, 0, 6, 2 and 2. rtype1 R3: a suppressed RF LINE NEXT PAGE ran its USE and took no page feed. rtype1 R2: a PF suppressed on page 2 only. cite: OK §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR9b 'there is no further processing to be done for the report group'; OK §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR12 'execute a page advance (and process page footing and page heading report groups) before actually presenting the body group'.
